def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    product_ids = list(entity_ids)

    empty_cols = [
        "num_items_total", "num_orders_total", "total_price", "avg_price",
        "std_price", "total_freight", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "num_reviews", "avg_total_paid", "avg_installments",
        "avg_credit_card_share", "recency_days", "avg_days_ago",
        "items_7d", "items_30d", "items_60d", "items_90d",
        "min_price", "max_price", "freight_share",
        "trend_30_90", "items_per_order", "share_last_quarter",
    ]
    empty_idx = pd.Index(product_ids, name="product_id")
    empty = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=empty_idx, columns=empty_cols)
    empty[["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]] = 9999.0
    return empty

    # ----- Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time (информация доступна) -----
    orders_before = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    if orders_before.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=empty_idx, columns=empty_cols)
        result[["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]] = 9999.0
        return result

    order_time = orders_before[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].rename(
        columns={"order_purchase_timestamp": "purchase_time"}
    )

    # Items: используем ts (момент покупки заказа позиции) — только до seed_time
    items_needed = items[items["ts"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "product_id", "price", "freight_value"]
    ]

    hist = items_needed.merge(order_time, on="order_id", how="inner")
    hist = hist[hist["product_id"].isin(product_ids)]

    if hist.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=empty_idx, columns=empty_cols)
        result[["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]] = 9999.0
        return result

    hist["days_ago"] = (seed_time - hist["purchase_time"]).dt.days.astype(float)

    for window in [7, 30, 60, 90]:
        hist[f"in_{window}d"] = (hist["days_ago"] <= window).astype(float)

    # ----- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы до seed_time -----
    if not reviews.empty:
        rev_before = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
        if not rev_before.empty:
            order_rev = rev_before.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].agg(
                ["mean", "count"]
            ).reset_index()
            order_rev.columns = ["order_id", "order_avg_score", "order_num_reviews"]
            hist = hist.merge(order_rev, on="order_id", how="left")
        else:
            hist["order_avg_score"] = np.nan
            hist["order_num_reviews"] = 0.0
    else:
        hist["order_avg_score"] = np.nan
        hist["order_num_reviews"] = 0.0

    # ----- Платежи: только те, что зафиксированы до seed_time (ts) -----
    if not payments.empty and "ts" in payments.columns:
        pay_before = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    else:
        pay_before = payments.iloc[0:0]

    if not pay_before.empty:
        pay = pay_before[["order_id", "payment_type",
                          "payment_installments", "payment_value"]].copy()
        pay["is_credit"] = (pay["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(float)
        order_pay = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
            order_total_paid=("payment_value", "sum"),
            order_avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            order_credit_share=("is_credit", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
        hist = hist.merge(order_pay, on="order_id", how="left")
    else:
        for col in ["order_total_paid", "order_avg_installments", "order_credit_share"]:
            hist[col] = np.nan

    # ----- Агрегации -----
    grouped = hist.groupby("product_id")

    features = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_items_total": grouped["price"].count(),
        "num_orders_total": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "avg_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "avg_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "avg_review_score": grouped["order_avg_score"].mean(),
        "num_reviews": grouped["order_num_reviews"].sum(),
        "avg_total_paid": grouped["order_total_paid"].mean(),
        "avg_installments": grouped["order_avg_installments"].mean(),
        "avg_credit_card_share": grouped["order_credit_share"].mean(),
        "recency_days": grouped["days_ago"].min(),
        "avg_days_ago": grouped["days_ago"].mean(),
        "items_7d": grouped["in_7d"].sum(),
        "items_30d": grouped["in_30d"].sum(),
        "items_60d": grouped["in_60d"].sum(),
        "items_90d": grouped["in_90d"].sum(),
        "items_per_order": grouped["order_id"].nunique()
            / grouped["order_id"].count().replace(0, np.nan),
        "share_last_quarter": grouped["in_90d"].mean(),
    })

    features["freight_share"] = features["total_freight"] / features["total_price"].replace(0, np.nan)
    features["trend_30_90"] = features["items_30d"] - (features["items_90d"] - features["items_30d"]) / 2.0

    features = features.reindex(empty_idx)

    for col in ["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(9999.0)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(product_ids)
    return features.astype(float)
